title: Our Favorite Floor Cleaners from Tineco Are on Sale for Black Friday
gist: Wired's promotional roundup of Tineco's Black Friday sale, with up to 60% off its floor-cleaning devices. Highlights are the Pure One Station 5 cordless vacuum at $249 (46% off, best price seen), the Carpet One Pro at $689 and the Floor One S7 steam mop at $489, plus discounts on the S9 and S7 Stretch lines.

insights.claim: Tineco is discounting Wired-tested floor cleaners by up to 60 percent for Black Friday. Wired's author says Black Friday is also one of the best times of year to buy home essentials, not just high-end electronics.
insights.speaker: Louryn Strampe
insights.so_what: Deep holiday discounts on home appliances point to heavy promotion in the floor-care category.
insights.locator: Black Friday is associated with deals

insights.claim: Tineco's Pure One Station 5 cordless vacuum, with a self-emptying dock, dropped to $249 from $459 (46% off), the best price Wired has seen. It works better on hardwood than on carpet.
insights.speaker: Louryn Strampe
insights.so_what: A record-low price on a self-emptying cordless vacuum shows how far floor-care pricing is falling.

insights.claim: Tineco's Carpet One Pro carpet cleaner was cut to $689 from $899 (23% off). It is heavy but has easy-to-rinse tanks, an LED mode screen, a fast drying mode and an upholstery accessory.
insights.speaker: Louryn Strampe
insights.so_what: Premium carpet cleaners got shallower discounts than vacuums.
insights.locator: This carpet cleaner is on the heavy side

insights.claim: Tineco's older Floor One S7 steam mop, now $489 (30% off $699), still holds up in Wired's testing. It is self-propelled and has built-in suction, but it struggles along baseboards, which the reviewer says every steam mop does.
insights.speaker: Louryn Strampe
insights.so_what: Older models being cleared at a discount suggests Tineco is clearing older inventory as newer generations arrive.
insights.quote: I truthfully have yet to meet a steam mop that doesn't
insights.locator: I haven't tested the newer version

insights.claim: Other Tineco Black Friday prices: FLOOR ONE STATION S9 Scientist Pro at $839 ($360 off), FLOOR ONE S9 Artist Steam at $599 ($350 off), FLOOR ONE S9 Artist Pro at $449 ($350 off), FLOOR ONE S7 Stretch Ultra at $299 ($300 off), FLOOR ONE S7 Stretch Steam at $439 ($260 off), and PURE ONE Station 5 Pro at $389 ($210 off).
insights.speaker: Louryn Strampe
insights.so_what: Discounts of $200-$360 across the lineup show how heavily Tineco is promoting.
